name: clip1
text: Cold wind blowing golden ginkgo leaves and red maple leaves across an empty stone path in late autumn, leaves swirling and tumbling toward the camera, bare branches swaying, the camera moving forward quickly. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip2
text: Time-lapse of a clear late-autumn sky at dawn, pink and orange clouds racing across, frost-covered grass with sparkling ice crystals in the foreground, mist drifting over a field, the camera sliding sideways. Realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip3
text: A flock of wild geese flying in a V formation across a pale gold evening sky, bare trees swaying in a cold wind below, clouds moving quickly, the camera tilting up to follow the birds. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip4
text: Cold rain turning to light sleet falling on a dark mountain village roof area with bare trees, strong wind bending the branches, grey clouds rolling fast over the ridge, the camera pushing forward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip5
text: Steam rising and swirling from a hot spring pool in a snowy-edge forest at dusk, a few snowflakes blowing past, trees swaying, warm lantern-like glow in the distance without any text, the camera drifting forward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.
